title: Craft holed by gunfire over Los Alamos

tellings.quote: My only theory, and that's all it is, is perhaps that whole uh like I said earlier, may have been a a a weapon, a 50 caliber rifle, machine gun or whatever when it was flying over Los Alamos, and maybe mass decompression,

plain: A researcher named Scott Ramsey offers a guess, and he calls it "only theory": a craft that came down in 1948 may have been hit by gunfire, something like a .50 caliber rifle or machine gun, while flying over Los Alamos, the New Mexico site where America built its atomic bomb. He thinks a hole like that might have caused "mass decompression" on board. He gives this as his own idea for why the craft and its crew were lost, and cites no source.
